info.title: Smart ERP
info.description: Smart ERP backend API. The only contract between the backend and the Angular frontend.

post.description:
Call `GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie` first, then send the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header.
Returns the same data as `GET /me`.

For a new user's invite (e.g. a company's first HR admin) or a forgot-password link (`purpose: reset`).
After this, the user logs in normally.
post.summary: Set password from an emailed link

post.description:
Always answers 204, whether or not the email belongs to an account (so it cannot be used to find accounts).
Active users get an email with a link to choose a new password.

get.description: Logo, background and announcements of an organization for the login page, plus announcements for everyone.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Organization slug from the login link, e.g. "kairuki".

get.description:
User, linked employee, company, modules enabled for the company, roles and permissions.
The frontend builds its menu and hides actions from this; the API still checks every request.
All modules that can be enabled for a company.
Filters: `filter[search]` (name, short name, TIN), `filter[is_active]`. Sort: `name`, `created_at` (prefix `-` for descending).

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Part of the name, short name or TIN.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Creates the company, its branches, enabled modules, default roles, and its first HR admin
(employee + user with role company-admin), then emails the admin a link to set their password.

patch.description: Send `is_active: false` to suspend it: its users can no longer log in or use the API.

put.description: Replaces the list of enabled modules (with optional expiry dates).

post.description:
Logo, login page photo and theme colors (multipart/form-data). Send `remove_logo` / `remove_login_background`
to go back to the default, or an empty color for the default color.
Emails the company admin a new link to set their password.

admin.description: The company admin (first HR user). Only on the detail endpoint.

has_set_password.description: False until the admin has used the invite link.

organization.description: Null when no (or an unknown or suspended) organization was asked for: show the neutral ERP branding.

is_platform_admin.description: System owner: manages client companies only, has no company.

primary_color.description: Theme colors (#rrggbb) or null for the ERP default.

modules.description: Modules this user can open: enabled for the company, not locked for their branch or for them.

roles.description: Assigned roles plus roles handed over to the user right now.

permissions.description: Effective permission names, e.g. "leave.approve-hr". The UI shows actions from this list only.

acting_roles.description: Roles the user holds temporarily for someone else (handover).

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons name without the "bi-" prefix.

is_core.description: Core modules are always available to every company.

slug.description: Key used by the frontend module manifest, e.g. "leave".

icon.description: Bootstrap Icons name without the "bi-" prefix, e.g. "person-circle".

slug.description: Login link name (/login?org=...). Generated from the short name or name when empty.

fiscal_year_start.description: Month and day the fiscal year starts, e.g. "07-01".

branches.description: At least one branch. The one marked is_headquarters (or the first) is the head office.

modules.description: Modules the company may use. Core modules are always available.

admin.description: The company's first HR admin. Gets an employee record, a user account and an invite email.

purpose.description: "invite" (default, link valid 3 days) or "reset" (forgot password, link valid 60 minutes).

logo.description: PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG, max 1 MB. Shown in the top bar, login page and documents.

login_background.description: Login page photo. JPG, PNG or WEBP, max 4 MB, landscape works best (1920×1080).

primary_color.description: Main color (buttons, links, active menu), e.g. "#0d6efd". Empty = default.

secondary_color.description: Top bar color. Empty = same as primary.

modules.description: The full list of enabled modules. Modules not listed are disabled.

is_active.description: false = suspended: the company's users can no longer log in.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
